tactics:
induction p with
| nil => simp [Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.isNonZero]
| cons x p ih =>
  obtain ⟨k, v⟩ := x
  intro h
  simp only [Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.isNonZero] at h
  simp only [Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.denote]
  split at h <;> simp_all [Nat.Internal.Linear.Var.denote] <;> omega
induction p <;> intro h <;> simp_all [Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.isNonZero, Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.denote] <;> grind
